freshbooks_refresh_token.title: Refresh Token
freshbooks_refresh_token.description: Optional legacy token seed. Local sign-in saves credentials privately without this field.

freshbooks_business_id.title: Business ID (optional)
freshbooks_business_id.description: The integer businessId to work in. Required for writes when your FreshBooks login belongs to more than one business; see freshbooks_get_identity for the list.

freshbooks_account_id.title: Account ID (optional)
freshbooks_account_id.description: The accountId of that same business. Only needed when FreshBooks reports no account_id for it, so invoices and other accounting writes know whose books to use.

freshbooks_redirect_uri.title: Redirect URI (optional)
freshbooks_redirect_uri.description: Registered redirect URI; must match what you registered (default https://localhost)

freshbooks_request_timeout_ms.title: Request timeout ms (optional)
freshbooks_request_timeout_ms.description: Per-request deadline for API calls, in milliseconds (default 30000)
